title: Navigation & page chrome
summary: Headers, rails, menus and footers that tell people where they are and get out of the way.

components.name: Navbar with mega dropdown
components.summary: Top navigation whose Product item opens a clean two-column panel with a featured card.
called: top menu where product opens a big panel
header with a dropdown full of links
website nav with a mega menu
menu bar that drops down with icons

anatomy.name: Brand
anatomy.text: Left edge, always home.

anatomy.name: Menu trigger
anatomy.text: A button, not a link: it opens the panel on click and on a short hover.

anatomy.name: Mega panel
anatomy.text: Two columns of links with one line each, and one featured card.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.text: Sign in as a link, one primary button.

components.prompt: Add a top navigation bar with a mega dropdown: <nav> with links, one <button aria-expanded aria-controls> that opens a panel of two link columns plus a featured card. Open on click and after a 120ms hover, close on Esc, outside click and focus leaving. Below 760px of container width, collapse into a menu button.
components.debug: Debug my mega menu. Rule out: the panel closing while the pointer crosses the gap (add a short close delay); hover-only opening with no click or keyboard path; links inside role="menu" (navigation is not a menu); focus trapped after Tab leaves. The symptom:

components.name: Hide-on-scroll header
components.summary: A sticky header that slides away when you scroll down and returns on the first scroll up.
called: header that disappears when you scroll down
top bar that comes back when scrolling up

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.text: Slides up past a small threshold, returns on the first scroll up.

anatomy.name: Links
anatomy.text: Stays reachable: the header never hides while it has focus.

components.prompt: Add a hide-on-scroll header: position: sticky, translate it up by 100% after scrolling down more than 8px, show it again on any scroll up, never hide while focus is inside, and pair it with scroll-padding-top so anchors are not covered.
components.debug: Debug my auto-hiding header. Rule out: jitter from tiny trackpad deltas (use a threshold); the header hiding at the very top; anchor links landing under it; scroll handlers without requestAnimationFrame. The symptom:

components.name: Collapsible app sidebar
components.summary: A left rail of sections that collapses to icons and remembers the choice.

anatomy.name: Workspace
anatomy.text: Who and where you are. Holds the collapse button.

anatomy.name: Current page
anatomy.text: Tinted, with an accent bar on the edge.

anatomy.name: Section label
anatomy.text: Groups secondary links. Collapses to a thin line.

anatomy.name: Collapse
anatomy.text: Shrinks the rail to icons; remembered for next time.

components.prompt: Add a collapsible app sidebar: <nav> with links (aria-current="page" on the active one), counts in tabular numbers, a section label, and a collapse button (aria-expanded) that shrinks it to an icon rail with title tooltips. Remember the choice; collapse automatically when the layout is narrow.
components.debug: Debug my sidebar. Rule out: icon-only links without accessible names when collapsed; the width transition causing text to wrap mid-animation (hide labels instantly); the active state set by colour only. The symptom:

components.name: Mobile bottom nav
components.summary: Up to five tabs pinned to the bottom of a phone screen, with a sliding active pill.
called: tab bar at the bottom of a phone app
icons along the bottom of the screen

anatomy.name: Active pill
anatomy.text: Slides to the tapped tab.

anatomy.name: Current tab
anatomy.text: Icon and label always together.

anatomy.name: Badge
anatomy.text: A count with a spoken label.

components.prompt: Add a bottom navigation bar for mobile: 3 to 5 links with icon plus label, aria-current="page" on the active one, a sliding highlight pill, badge counts with aria-labels, and padding for env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
components.debug: Debug my bottom nav. Rule out: more than 5 items; labels hidden so icons must be guessed; content hidden under the bar (add bottom padding to the page); the home indicator overlapping (safe-area-inset-bottom). The symptom:

components.name: Magnifying dock
components.summary: A row of app icons that swell as the pointer passes, like a desktop dock.
called: mac dock where icons get bigger
icons that grow when you hover

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.text: Grows with a cosine falloff from the pointer.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.text: Separates apps from settings.

components.prompt: Add a magnifying dock: a row of icon links that scale with a cosine falloff from the pointer x position (max 1.6×, range about 140px), magnify on keyboard focus too, show a label tooltip, and stay still under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my dock. Rule out: layout thrashing from reading rects inside the scale loop without rAF; items without accessible names; magnification under reduced motion; touch devices magnifying on scroll. The symptom:

components.summary: A 9-dot button that opens a grid of apps, navigable with arrow keys.

components.prompt: Add a waffle app launcher: a nine-dot button with aria-haspopup="menu" opening a 3-column grid of role="menuitem" links (icon + name). Left/Right move one item, Up/Down move a row, Esc closes.
components.debug: Debug my app launcher. Rule out: Up/Down moving one item instead of one row; the panel overflowing the viewport edge; icons without visible names. The symptom:

components.name: Account menu

components.prompt: Add an account menu: an avatar button with aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded opening role="menu" with the name and email at the top, profile and settings items, a separator and sign out last.
components.debug: Debug my account menu. Rule out: the identity block focusable as an item; sign out placed first; menu items as plain divs without roles; focus not returning to the avatar. The symptom:

components.name: Scrollspy “On this page”
components.summary: A rail of headings that highlights where you are as you read.
called: on this page list on the right of docs
table of contents that highlights as you scroll
section links that follow the page

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.text: "On this page", short and quiet.

anatomy.name: Current section
anatomy.text: The last heading that passed 30% of the viewport.

anatomy.name: Marker

components.prompt: Add an "On this page" rail: links to section headings, aria-current="location" on the heading that most recently passed 30% from the top (last one when scrolled to the end), and a sliding marker bar. Clicking scrolls and moves focus to the heading.
components.debug: Debug my scrollspy. Rule out: the last section never activating because it cannot reach the threshold; an IntersectionObserver highlighting two links at once; headings hidden under a sticky header (scroll-margin-top). The symptom:

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: A trail of parent pages that collapses its middle into “…” when space runs out.
called: path at the top showing where you are

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.text: Always shown.

anatomy.name: Collapsed levels
anatomy.text: The middle folds into "…" when space runs out.

anatomy.name: Current page
anatomy.text: Not a link. Truncates last.

components.prompt: Add breadcrumbs: <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with an ordered list, the current page as text with aria-current="page", CSS chevron separators, and a "…" button that replaces middle levels when the trail does not fit.
components.debug: Debug my breadcrumbs. Rule out: separators read aloud (draw them in CSS); the current page as a link; the trail wrapping onto two lines on mobile instead of collapsing. The symptom:

components.name: Step indicator wizard
components.summary: Numbered steps that tick off as you move through a multi-step flow.
called: numbered circles across the top of checkout

anatomy.name: Done step

anatomy.name: Current step
anatomy.text: Ringed in the accent.

anatomy.name: Status line
anatomy.text: Says "Step 2 of 4: Workspace".

components.prompt: Add a step indicator: an ordered list of steps with aria-current="step" on the current one, done steps filled with a tick, connecting lines that fill as you progress, a live "Step 2 of 4" line, and Back/Continue buttons.
components.debug: Debug my stepper. Rule out: steps clickable in an order the flow does not allow; progress shown by colour only; Back enabled on step 1; the connector lines misaligned with the circles. The symptom:

components.name: Pagination bar
components.summary: Previous, next and a compact page list with ellipses and a results summary.
called: page numbers at the bottom of a list
pager with dots in the middle

anatomy.name: Current page
anatomy.text: Outlined, never just bold.

anatomy.name: Gap
anatomy.text: At most seven slots: first, last, neighbours, two gaps.

anatomy.name: Summary
anatomy.text: "Showing 126–150 of 600".

components.prompt: Add pagination: <nav aria-label="Pagination"> with Previous/Next, at most seven page slots (first, last, current ±1, ellipses), aria-current="page", and a results summary in tabular numbers.
components.debug: Debug my pagination. Rule out: dozens of page links; Previous enabled on page 1; focus lost after changing page; ellipses rendered as buttons. The symptom:

components.name: Balanced footer
components.summary: Brand line, four even link columns and a single legal row.
called: links at the very bottom of the site

anatomy.name: Brand line
anatomy.text: One sentence about the company.

anatomy.name: Columns
anatomy.text: Three to five columns of three to five links.

anatomy.name: Legal row
anatomy.text: One line. Nothing else below it.

components.prompt: Add a footer: a brand line, 3–5 balanced link columns under small uppercase headings in <nav aria-label="Footer">, and a single legal row. Two columns on narrow screens.
components.debug: Debug my footer. Rule out: columns of very different lengths; tiny link text under 13px; low-contrast grey links; a newsletter, socials and a second sitemap competing below. The symptom:

components.name: Floating pill nav
components.summary: A compact floating pill of links with a highlight that glides between them.
called: pill shaped navbar in the middle

anatomy.name: Highlight
anatomy.text: Glides under the hovered link and rests on the current one.

anatomy.name: Call to action
anatomy.text: The only filled link.

components.prompt: Add a floating pill nav: a rounded bar of links with a highlight that glides to the hovered or focused link and rests on the current one, plus one filled call-to-action link.
components.debug: Debug my pill nav. Rule out: the highlight jumping on first paint; the highlight not following keyboard focus; the bar overflowing on mobile. The symptom:

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Underline tabs with a sliding indicator and arrow-key switching.
called: tab bar with a sliding line

anatomy.name: Selected tab
anatomy.text: Left and Right switch tabs immediately.

anatomy.name: Indicator
anatomy.text: Slides under the selected tab.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.text: Focusable, so keyboard users can reach its content.

components.prompt: Add tabs: role="tablist" with role="tab" buttons (aria-selected, aria-controls), role="tabpanel" panels, automatic activation with Left/Right/Home/End and a roving tabindex, and an underline indicator that slides.
components.debug: Debug my tabs. Rule out: all tabs in the tab order; arrow keys not activating; panels without aria-labelledby; the indicator measured before fonts load. The symptom:

components.name: Speed dial (FAB)
components.summary: A round floating button that fans out three labelled actions above it.
called: round plus button in the corner that opens more buttons

anatomy.name: Floating button
anatomy.text: The plus turns into a close mark when open.

anatomy.name: Action
anatomy.text: Icon plus a visible label; never icons alone.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Sits on a surface so it reads over any content.

components.prompt: Add a speed dial: a 52px round accent button fixed to the bottom-right with aria-haspopup="menu"; opening fans out 3 labelled mini actions above it with a short spring and a 35ms stagger, the plus rotates 45°, arrow keys move between actions, Esc and outside clicks close and return focus.
components.debug: Debug my speed dial. Rule out: actions with icons but no labels; the menu still focusable while hidden (use visibility: hidden when closed); the FAB covering page content without padding at the bottom; animations that ignore reduced motion. The symptom:

components.name: Back-to-top button
components.summary: Appears once you have scrolled, shows reading progress in its ring and takes you back up.
called: arrow button that takes you back up the page
button that appears when you scroll down

anatomy.name: Button
anatomy.text: Out of the way until it is useful.

anatomy.name: Progress ring
anatomy.text: How far through the page you are.

components.prompt: Add a back-to-top button: hidden until the reader has scrolled 40% of a screen, a 44px round button bottom-right whose ring shows scroll progress, smooth scroll to the top (instant under reduced motion), and focus moved to the first heading after it scrolls.
components.debug: Debug my back-to-top button. Rule out: scroll handlers that run layout on every event (throttle with rAF); the button covering a footer link or cookie banner; focus left on the button after jumping so the next Tab goes back down. The symptom:

components.name: Drill-down menu
components.summary: Mobile navigation where each submenu slides in over its parent with a back row.
called: mobile menu where submenus slide in
menu with back arrow to go up a level

anatomy.name: Back row
anatomy.text: Names where you are; Left arrow or Esc also goes back.

anatomy.name: Link
anatomy.text: Real links for pages, buttons only for submenus.

components.prompt: Add a drill-down mobile menu: each level is a list; items with children are buttons with a chevron that slide the submenu in from the right, a back row at the top of every submenu names the level and slides back; focus lands on the back row going in and on the parent item coming out; Right/Left arrows and Esc work too.
components.debug: Debug my drill-down menu. Rule out: hidden levels still in the tab order (use hidden or visibility: hidden); focus lost to <body> after a level change; submenus as links to "#" instead of buttons; animations that ignore reduced motion. The symptom:

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Cards that scroll sideways with snap points, arrow buttons and dots; it never moves on its own.
called: row of cards you swipe sideways

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.text: Real scrolling, so touch and trackpads just work.

anatomy.name: Dots
anatomy.text: The current dot stretches; each dot jumps to a slide.

components.prompt: Add a carousel of post cards: a horizontally scrolling list with scroll-snap, cards at min(78%, 240px), Previous/Next buttons that disable at the ends, dots that track the scroll position and jump on click, arrow keys on the focused track, no auto-advance, and smooth scrolling off under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my carousel. Rule out: auto-advancing slides people cannot pause; translateX-based sliders that break touch scrolling; dots out of sync after a swipe; the page scrolling sideways instead of the track. The symptom:

burger menu that turns into an x

components.prompt: Add a mobile hamburger menu: a 56px bar with the brand and a 40px toggle whose three lines morph into an X, aria-expanded and a label that changes to "Close menu", a panel under the bar with large links (current page marked) and the two account actions at the bottom, focus trapped while open, Esc and link clicks close it.
components.debug: Debug my hamburger menu. Rule out: the page behind still scrolling and focusable; a div with a click handler instead of a button; the icon morph ignoring reduced motion; the menu hiding the one primary action. The symptom:

components.prompt: Build a session list for an agent sidebar: a header with a ghost "New session" button and a search icon, then sessions grouped under small project headings with a folder icon. Each row is a link with a 10px state mark (spinning ring = running, amber dot = needs you, green tick = done, hollow ring = idle, each with a visually hidden label), a one-line truncated title and a short relative time in muted tabular figures. The current session has aria-current and a tinted row. Up and Down arrows move between rows across groups.
components.debug: Debug my session list. Rule out: state shown by colour alone; titles wrapping to two lines; full timestamps where "2h" is enough; spinners that keep animating under reduced motion; every row bold; groups with no heading. The symptom:

components.name: Reading progress
components.summary: A thin accent bar at the top that fills as an article is read.
called: the line at the top that grows as you scroll
how far through the article am I bar

anatomy.name: Bar
anatomy.text: 3px, the accent colour, scaled from the left. No layout work while scrolling.

components.prompt: Add a reading progress bar to a long article: a sticky 3px strip at the top of the page (or of the scrolling panel) whose inner bar is scaled on the x axis from 0 to 1 with the scroll position, updated at most once per frame from a passive scroll listener. Accent colour, no track, no percentage text. Mark it aria-hidden. Use it only on long-form pages (articles, docs, legal), never on landing pages or app screens.
components.debug: Debug my reading progress bar. Rule out: animating width (use scale); a scroll handler that runs layout on every event; progress measured over the whole page when only the article should count (data-target); a thick or gradient bar; using it on a short page where it jumps from 0 to 100. The symptom:

components.name: Row list
components.summary: Grouped navigation rows for a settings or account home: icon, label, current value and a chevron.
called: list of settings with little arrows on the right
rows you tap to go deeper

anatomy.name: Row
anatomy.text: 48px, the whole row is the link. Rows that go somewhere end in a chevron.

anatomy.name: Current value
anatomy.text: Muted, right-aligned: saves a tap to find out.

anatomy.name: Count
anatomy.text: Only for things that need attention.

anatomy.name: Action row
anatomy.text: Does something instead of going somewhere: no chevron.

components.prompt: Build a grouped row list for a settings home: a <nav> of sections, each with a small uppercase heading and a rounded, bordered <ul>. Every row is one 48px link filling the row: an 18px line icon in secondary ink, a medium-weight label, the current value muted and right-aligned (or a small accent count when something needs attention), and a muted chevron. Dividers are hairlines that start after the icon. A row that performs an action (Sign out) is a <button> in its own group with no chevron; destructive ones use the danger tone. No coloured icon tiles.
components.debug: Debug my row list. Rule out: only the label being clickable; chevrons on rows that do not navigate; rows under 44px on touch; a rainbow of icon background tiles; values that wrap onto a second line; toggles and links mixed in one group (use settings-list for switches). The symptom:

called: the bar at the top of a phone app with the back arrow
big title that shrinks when you scroll

anatomy.name: Back
anatomy.text: A chevron and the name of the screen it returns to. 44px tall.

anatomy.name: Large title
anatomy.text: The screen name at rest. Scrolls away with the content.

anatomy.name: Small title
anatomy.api: aria-hidden when a large title exists
anatomy.text: Fades in once the large title has gone.

anatomy.name: Action
anatomy.text: One text action at most.

components.prompt: Build a mobile app bar: a sticky <header> with a 44px row holding a back button (chevron plus the name of the previous screen, aria-label "Back to …"), a centred title, and at most one text action on the right, both in the accent text colour. With data-size="large", add an <h1> large title (30px display type) under the row that scrolls away with the content; when it has gone, fade the small title in and draw a hairline under the bar. Stickiness is CSS (negative top equal to the large title height); a small IntersectionObserver sets data-scrolled. Keep it opaque so content never shows through.
